title: Quantum Spectrodynamics: Deriving Standard Model Parameters from the Geometry of Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
description: Quantum Spectrodynamics (QSD) is a theoretical framework that derives the gauge couplings, particle masses, and cosmological constant of the Standard Model from the algebraic geometry of the [[5,1,3]] quantum error-correcting code. The framework requires zero free parameters beyond the Planck mass. Three fundamental constants — the holographic bit density Hb₄ = 1/(4 ln 2), geometric strain ς = 3/(80 φ²), and spectral bond ϖ = πφ² — yield predictions agreeing with experiment to within 0.002%–1.2% across six independent observables. This repository contains the complete manuscript suite (main preprint + 7 supplements + 1 technical note), Python simulation code, quantum circuit implementations, and interactive 3D visualizations.
